description: Consumer fixtures for the xebench benchmarks contract 1.2 (data/benchmarks.schema.json, docs/WEBSITE-HANDOFF.md): build.runtimes, engineVersion and bindingVersion. Each file is a complete envelope. expect=accept files must load and render; expect=reject files must be refused as a whole, keeping the consumer's compatible fallback. tests/test_contract_1_2.py checks every entry against scripts/validate_data.mjs.

fixtures.notes: LiteRT-LM NPU with dispatch runtime and QAIRT; no binding
1.2 is additive: rows without runtimes are unchanged
names come from a closed list
versions are short version strings, never free text
